site_token.description: issued only when the server's own callback to {home_url}/wp-json/babilim/v1/challenge?nonce= succeeds and returns the same proof; any callback failure yields 403 verification_required (with error.reason) instead of a token

verified.description: always true in a 200 response: a site whose callback cannot be confirmed (unreachable, timed out or invalid) receives 403 verification_required and no site_token
